title.narrative: GEF GOLD+ Bolivia: Enhancing the formalization and mercury reduction in artisanal and small scale gold mining (ASGM) in the Plurinational State of Bolivia

description.narrative: Child project part of the GOLD+ programme on artisanal gold mining under the leadership of Conservation International and with funding from the GEF. The project was developed at the request of the GEF OFP that followed discussions with the UNIDO Field Office and in consultation with several stakeholders during a mission carried out in March 2020.
